title: Use SQS for async jobs instead of Kafka
decision: All new async jobs (email, exports, retries) go through SQS with a dead-letter queue. We will not run our own Kafka cluster.
context: Email and export jobs needed a queue. Kafka and SQS were both proposed.
rationale: SQS is managed and cheap at our volume
Nobody on the team wants to operate Kafka

actions.task: Write the queue module and DLQ alarms

title: Adopt pnpm for all JavaScript repos
decision: We switch every JS repo from npm to pnpm by the end of Q3.
context: Install times in CI were over four minutes and disk use on runners kept growing.
rationale: pnpm halved CI install time in a trial

actions.task: Migrate the web repo first and write a migration note

title: Keep on-call to one week rotations
decision: On-call stays a one-week rotation with a Tuesday handover.
context: Some people asked for shorter shifts after a noisy week.
rationale: Handover overhead makes short rotations worse
Tuesday avoids handing over a weekend's mess on Monday
